title: Add ticket
purpose: Link a ticket that a nonconformance concerns, by its ticket number.
summary: Link a ticket this nonconformance concerns, by its number. Only a ticket you can open can be linked. The owner or a supervisor does this.

tasks.title: Link a ticket
steps: On the record select [[Add ticket]] under Linked tickets.
Type the [[Ticket number]], such as REQ-000123, and select [[Add ticket]].

tasks.title: Undo a link added by mistake
steps: On the record select [[Remove]] beside the ticket and give a reason.

good_to_know: A number you cannot open gets the same answer as one that does not exist: No ticket with that number you can open.
The ticket's timeline records the link, and the ticket's page lists this nonconformance.
You can type the number as REQ-000123, req-123 or just 123.
People who cannot open the ticket do not see it among the record's linked tickets.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Opens from Add ticket under Linked tickets on the record, as a dialog or a full page. Only the owner or a supervisor (the admin role included) may open it; anyone else is refused. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

items.label: Ticket number
items.description: Required, up to 40 characters. The ticket's number, with or without the REQ- prefix and leading zeros. Any ticket you may open now can be linked, a complaint or not, open or closed.

items.label: Add ticket
items.description: Links the ticket and confirms Ticket linked. The record's history records Ticket linked; the ticket's timeline records Linked to nonconformance NC-000123, and its Nonconformances section lists the record.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record without linking anything.

items.label: Tickets you cannot open
items.description: A number that does not exist, and one for a ticket you may not open, such as one in a restricted category, get the same answer: No ticket with that number you can open.

items.label: Already linked
items.description: A ticket already linked to this record is refused: This ticket is already linked. A ticket whose link was removed can be linked again.

items.label: Versions
items.description: Linking advances the version of the record and of the ticket, so forms opened earlier on either are refused as stale and must be reloaded. If the record changed after you opened this form: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details.

items.label: Closed record
items.description: A closed nonconformance does not change. A supervisor can reopen it.

items.label: Signed out by a time limit
items.description: When a time limit signs you out, what you typed here is kept for 24 hours, for you in that browser only, and comes back on this page when you sign in again there (a form open in a dialog opens again on its own page). It keeps the version of the record you typed against: if the record changed since, the page says This record changed after you typed it, and saving is refused with your typing on the form. Copy what you need, then select Discard to open the form as the record stands. It comes back even where the form is no longer offered, for example after the record was closed.
